scene_overview.short_description: An ink-wash swordswoman seen from behind extends her katana in a full horizontal strike across a black void.
scene_overview.style: monochrome ink-wash anime, dramatic and restrained
scene_overview.background_analysis: Genuinely near-pure video black on the whole left half and corners; the gray smoke on the right is attached to the subject, not a background field.

canvas_analysis.rotation_reasoning: stored orientation matches scene content, no rotation cues found — gravity cues (hanging sleeves, upright stance, falling hair strands) all point down in the stored frame; a landscape file with an upright scene must NOT be rotated

motion_estimate.expected_movement: Blade shimmer along the katana; sleeves and hair sway; smoke drifts.

color_calibration.palette_notes: Video black, near-pure at all clean corner samples (#000000-#030304 measured) — rule 5 applies: report the near-pure value with confidence. Excluded the kanji inscription above the blade and the faint GIF stamp at the bottom-right corner from all samples.

background_layout.notes: One flat near-black field; the right-side smoke belongs to the subject.

main_subject.label: swordswoman mid-strike with fully extended katana

middle_zone.description: extended arm + katana blade running to the LEFT frame edge (thin extension), inflated

bottom_zone.description: hakama skirt, cropped at bottom, inflated

safe_typography_zones.strategy_description: Free negative space sits left of the subject only: top-left above the blade (clear of the kanji) and bottom-left below it. Both embedded elements are subordinate, so the words may echo the blade/wind theme of the inscription.

equalizer_canvas_zone.notes: The strip crosses the hakama on the right; unavoidable in a full-height landscape subject.
